newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers soften, buyers surge in.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers soften, buyers surge in.

text.p: Bunker prices in Rotterdam came off on Tuesday, leading to healthy buying with a number of players expecting price rises imminently, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil traded as low as $87 fob as the efforts of one trading house selling product from June 20 brought the barge market down.
Total ARA volumes reached 20,000 tonnes by most estimates. Some said they had seen as many as 30,000 tonnes of enquiries.
Suppliers said the rise of the rest of the energy complex, high prices elsewhere and the efforts of one major to urge the market higher, persuaded a number of players that prices would shortly rise.
The Hamburg market was, by contrast, calm, with few enquiries seen.
The Mediterranean was also calm in most ports, although a little more animated than during Monday's torpor. Prices were broadly unchanged, but gas oil was expected to rise.
Egyptian fuel oil quotes went up by $2 a tonne.
